name: São Tomé and Príncipe
summary_text: São Tomé and Príncipe demands real caution. Same-sex conduct decriminalised in 2012; small, peaceful, tourism-growing islands; no LGR; no documented anti-trans violence; thin community.

sources.title: Human Dignity Trust
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: Only the Human Dignity Trust homepage was retrievable at fetch time (no São Tomé and Príncipe-specific page); São Tomé and Príncipe decriminalised same-sex conduct in 2012.

Wikiwand (Wikipedia mirror): LGBTQ rights in São Tomé and Príncipe - same-sex activity legal since the November 2012 Penal Code; one of the few African states to sign the UN SOGI joint statement; LGBTQ people face stigmatisation.

Everything Explained summary: legal since 2012; equal age of consent 18 since 2021 (Law 15/2021, previously 16); no relationship recognition or adoption; Labour Code 2019 Article 16.2 bans workplace discrimination based on sexual orientation; no gender-identity recognition.

sources.title: LGBTQ rights in São Tomé and Príncipe — Wikipedia Republished // WIKI 2
sources.claim_summary: WIKI2 (Wikipedia mirror): LGBTQ rights in São Tomé and Príncipe - legal since 2012, sexual-orientation discrimination protections, no relationship recognition, no adoption, no military, no gender-identity recognition.
Wikiwand (Wikipedia mirror, articles URL): LGBTQ rights in São Tomé and Príncipe - same content as the legacy Wikiwand page; legal status, protections and stigmatisation.

sources.title: LGBT rights in São Tomé and Príncipe - Alchetron, the free social encyclopedia
sources.claim_summary: Alchetron (Wikipedia-derived): LGBT rights in São Tomé and Príncipe - same-sex activity legal under the 2012 Penal Code; age of consent 16 regardless of orientation (pre-2021); no relationship recognition; no discrimination protections (per this older snapshot); ICCPR signed 31 Oct 1995.
